description: Current LLMs show significant performance improvements on situational awareness tasks when provided with 'situating prompts' that remind them of their nature as AI models.

instances.assertion: Current LLMs show significant performance improvements on situational awareness tasks when provided with 'situating prompts' that remind them of their nature as AI models.
Situating prompts (reminding the model it is an LLM) significantly improve performance on situational awareness benchmarks.
Detailed situating prompts can significantly improve AI performance on situational awareness tasks.
